51:["$","details",null,{"className":"acc","style":{"marginTop":10},"children":[["$","summary",null,{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"How confidence is set"}],["$","span",null,{"className":"small muted","children":"It follows the kind of evidence, not judgement."}]]}],["$","div",null,{"className":"acc-body","children":["$","ul",null,{"className":"tight small","children":[[["$","li","The customer's own statement",{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"The customer's own statement"}]," (","high"," confidence at most): ","The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record."]}],["$","li","Regulatory or securities filing",{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Regulatory or securities filing"}]," (","high"," confidence at most): ","A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship."]}],["$","li","Independent press",{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Independent press"}]," (","high"," confidence at most): ","Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment."]}],["$","li","Joint announcement",{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Joint announcement"}]," (","medium"," confidence at most): ","A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer."]}],["$","li","Vendor case study",{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Vendor case study"}]," (","medium"," confidence at most): ","The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation."]}],["$","li","Vendor mention only",{"children":[["$","strong",null,{"children":"Vendor mention only"}]," (","low"," confidence at most): ","A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer."]}]],["$","li",null,{"children":"An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium."}],["$","li",null,{"children":"A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer."}]]}]}]]}]
